THE COMPANIES ACT, 2017 (XIX of 2017)
(COMPANY LIMITED BY SHARES)

Articles of Association
Of
Zameen Centre (SMC-Private) Limited

THE COMPANIES ACT, 2017 (XIX of 2017)
(Company Limited by Shares)
ARTICLES OF ASSOCIATION
OF
“Zameen Centre (SMC-PRIVATE) LIMITED”

1. The Regulations as set out in part I I of Table A of First Schedule of the Companies Act, 2017 (the “Act”) shall
be the regulations of Zameen Centre (SMC-Private) Limited (the “Company”).
SINGLE MEMBER COMPANY
2. The company is a single member company and as such being a private company limited by
shares—
(a)
it shall not invite the public to subscribe for any shares of the company;
(b)

the company shall not register any share(s) in the name of two or more persons to
hold one or more shares jointly; and

(c)

number of the members of the company shall be limited to one.

SHARES
3. The company may alter its share capital in accordance with section 85 of the Act.
4. Share certificate shall be issued under the seal of the Company and shall be signed by the
member director or the non-member director, as the case may be.

DIRECTOR
5. The company shall always have the sole member or in case it is not a natural person its nominee, as a director
but it may have such number of other director(s) who fulfil the conditions as specified in section 153 of the Act.
Mr. Shahzad Masih shall be the first director of the Company.
